item.title: Episode 1: Claude News Edition
item.description: Andrew and Ava cover confirmed Claude news through October 23, 2026: Fable 5 and its return, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5, plus the Claude Duet research preview, the Claude Security public beta, and Claude Platform on Google Cloud. Unconfirmed Fable 5.5 rumors stay labeled as rumors, including a Tuesday, October 27 date to watch.
